purpose: Specify and implement a minimal pre-action receiver-service observation in a new isolated module before any new replay or fitting.
one_change: Add the count of currently onboard receiver passengers whose native current stage0 destStop equals the current stop, plus explicit stage-read completeness. Describe the existing ready-time field as estimated, not verified completion.
inputs: Current getPersonIDList(receiver) and getStage(person,0) only; no later alighting, future journey stages or permanent legacy transfer/end-stop fields.
unknowns: If any onboard current stage is unavailable or unsupported, preserve incomplete/unknown instead of treating missing people as zero. This count is not remaining service seconds.
verification: Small synthetic interface tests for current-leg versus later-leg destinations, incomplete reads and no future-field dependency. Bind observation before apply and keep time/state unchanged in the interface design. Real native validity requires a separately authorized passive replay.
old_files: read-only; do not backfill v120/v121/v122 contexts or targets
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
decision: Finish the isolated observation contract and tests, then propose a bounded passive replay if needed; no automatic replay, model fit or controller deployment.
name: mcwm_receiver_service_v124_20261029

interface.provenance: people contains current-stage values only; IDs are not predictor inputs
interface.timing: Called at the original policy entry before apply; no native advancement or setters.
interface.integration: Future passive replay stores this observation beside the unchanged v120 context at the same root; no frozen data backfill or controller wiring in this stage.

meaning: Number of currently onboard receiver passengers whose supported current driving stage ends at this stop. It is not a service-time estimate or a verified completion flag.
sample_budget: One receiver root remains one sample; passenger-stage provenance does not expand the existing285 slots per day.
